critical_code_review_comments: Review request lists banner cropper testids as 'banner-editor', 'banner-editor-file', 'banner-editor-cropper', but Profile.jsx passes testid='profile-banner-editor' when instantiating BannerEditor, so the actual DOM testids are 'profile-banner-editor', 'profile-banner-editor-file', 'profile-banner-editor-cropper', etc. Not a functional bug — the component correctly propagates the testid prop — but the review request/handoff documentation should be updated to reference the profile-prefixed testids to avoid confusion for the next agent.

Feed media filter chips are multi-select (OR-combined). Clicking 'Thoughts' while 'Polls' is still active shows both — this is the expected behavior of the multi-filter design, but the review-request wording 'click Thought filter only' implicitly assumes the previous filter is deselected. First run of the poll filter test misinterpreted this as a bug; on second pass with explicit toggle-off, Thoughts-only correctly excludes the poll. Consider adding a subtle 'Clear filters' link or making chips exclusive-select if UX confusion is common; else keep as-is.

widget picker registry-picker-realm-disabled-banner surfaces '13 widgets currently disabled by an admin and hidden from this picker' — good transparency but the number (13) should be verified periodically as widget registry changes; currently /api/widgets/available returns 7 renderable placement=realm widgets, so 13 disabled implies 20 total widgets are gated to realm placement, of which only 7 are surfaced. This looks correct given current registry contents.

console spam from https://example.com/v.mp4 CORS-blocked video request appears on every page load — likely a legacy test video URL still referenced somewhere in seed content or a widget preview. Not blocking, but adds noise to browser console.
